Title text 'D14, signed-MW six: injected lag-only load-shift, -50% of capacity for 15 days (October 2025) Only the lag inputs carry the shift, so the black dashed line (the observed power) is the NRA. Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the shift in the lags. Day-ahead forecasts issued at 09:00 the day before; mean of two seeds and two refits. Median: line.'
text.tspan: D14, signed-MW six: injected lag-only load-shift, -50% of capacity for 15 days (October 2025)
Only the lag inputs carry the shift, so the black dashed line (the observed power) is the NRA. Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the shift in the lags.
Day-ahead forecasts issued at 09:00 the day before; mean of two seeds and two refits. Median: line.
